_concept: The 'quiet twin' of Facility Coach — chosen by Collier 2026-08-26. Same Poppins type system, ZERO accent colour. Reads as the person behind the company: obviously related, deliberately quieter. Face and delivery carry the clip, not colour.

colors._rule: No accent colour. Do NOT introduce ice, yellow or gold into Collier captions — that is Facility Coach's language.

emphasis_rule: WEIGHT only (Poppins Bold -> ExtraBold -> Black) plus size on single-word cues. A second voice / quoted objection is marked with italic + quotes, never colour.
end_card: Typeset name only — COLLIER BUTTGEN in Poppins 800 on ink #16171C. No logo (none exists yet).

music._how_to_change: Drop royalty-free tracks in brand/music/, set enabled=true, and re-render. Adding music is a re-render, not a rebuild.
